from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement')
handoff = root / 'release-owner-handoff'
files = {
 'index.html': root / 'director-buyer-preview/index-preview.html',
 '7c2e9a41d86b35f0e1a4c97d2b58e360.txt': handoff / 'served-ownership.txt',
 'llms.txt': handoff / 'served-llms.txt',
 'transform.py': handoff / 'served-transform.py.txt',
 'verify.py': handoff / 'served-verify.py.txt',
 'verify_example.py': handoff / 'served-verify_example.py.txt',
 'fixtures/after-shopify.csv': handoff / 'served-after-shopify.csv',
 'fixtures/before-images.csv': handoff / 'served-before-images.csv',
 'fixtures/before-variants.csv': handoff / 'served-before-variants.csv',
}
sha = lambda content: hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
receipt = {'missing': [str(path) for path in files.values() if not path.is_file()], 'manifest': {}}
if not receipt['missing']:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
  candidate = Path(temp)
  for name, source in files.items():
   destination = candidate / name
   destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
   receipt['manifest'][name] = sha(destination.read_bytes())
  baseline = (root / 'placement-live-readback.html').read_bytes()
  preview = (candidate / 'index.html').read_bytes()
  hrefs = lambda data: re.findall(rb'href\s*=\s*[\x22\x27]([^\x22\x27]*)', data, re.I)
  receipt['homepage_binding'] = sha(baseline) == '8bb6898a489669b02cd4db20f10abbe524a2d87b4c4590d233b49d337eb83bcc' and sha(preview) == 'c51c52bccd913d808ece4a7dec4d0a0bb13fbfd0c0ca201f30a9fd7eb62c0ab7'
  receipt['same_href_sequence'] = hrefs(baseline) == hrefs(preview)
  if receipt['homepage_binding'] and receipt['same_href_sequence']:
   run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'verify_example.py'], cwd=candidate, capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=30)
   receipt['verification'] = {'exit_code': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr}
receipt['scope'] = 'Temporary offline reconstruction. No site directory written, host dry run performed, or customer activity observed.'
out = handoff / 'isolated-candidate-rehearsal.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
